A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the OFDM implementation is not only an excellent choice for the exploration and evaluation of the HMAs but it is also a good choice for the implementation of the OFDM transceivers in future.
the HMA can be an efficient platform for the implementation of the computationally intensive tasks and the NoC can be used to efficiently exchange data among the cores and CGRAs.
the HMA can provide a near optimal solution for computationally intensive tasks like FFTs and can also provide a general purpose solution for the other tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a thorough design space exploration of a HMA by using a computationally demanding application like OFDM is an effective way to find an optimized design.
the HMA platform can be designed to be optimal for the applications that are to be executed on it by using a proper design methodology.
, the HMA can be a promising solution for a large class of applications that require a combination of parallel and serial processing.
